raw_segments.text: Father Conway crossed to Mount G Square. He thought, but not for long, of soldiers and
sailors whose legs had been shot off by cannonballs, ending their days in some pauper ward and
of Cardinal Walsy's words. If I had served my god as I have served my king, he would
not have abandoned me in my old days. He walked by the tree-sheet of sunny-winking leaves,
and towards him came the wife of Mr. David's Sheehee MP.
